name: Scale Or Fail
tagline: Voice-first system-design interview practice graded by AI agents against a rubric.

awards: [MLH] Best Use of Vultr // [MLH] Meilleure utilisation de Vultr

problem: System-design interviews are increasing and are hard to practise out loud.
solution: Users explain an architecture aloud; real-time transcription feeds agents that analyse the reasoning and grade it.
demo_moment: Team-described: answer a design prompt aloud and get a graded report.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “[MLH] Best Use of Vultr // [MLH] Meilleure utilisation de Vultr” among 260 submissions.
Practises defending a design, not just knowing it.

lessons: Train the format of the test, not only its content.
